Title: LSJ/Rules Team: Question about Kurt Densch

Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
Hello folks!

Was browsing some of the new minions and I noticed an odd ability on
Kurt Densch: he can pay 1 blood to move the top card of your library
to the bottom by paying 1 blood during your untap phase. I wonder...
can he do it multiple times, paying 1 blood each time? I can't find a
reason why not, but it sounds a little off. Could be quite strong,
actually, helping in those decks that like Storage Annexes and so
forth.

(quoted from the Crypt Monger, www.monger.vekn.org)

Kurt Densch
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------Clan:
Nosferatu
Capacity: 8

Camarilla
Group: 3

Ability: During your untap phase, you may look at the top card of your
library, and Kurt may burn 1 blood to move that card to the bottom of
your library. +1 intercept.

Disciplines :

Inferior Animalism
Inferior Auspex
Inferior Celerity
Superior Obfuscate
Superior Potence

Blessings,

Patrick van der Reest
Columbus, OH
